segments.comment: A debug Valkyrie creates the Wizard of Yendor and slays him with #wizkill, which makes her a demigod and starts the intervention countdown. She creates a second Wizard, sends him off the level with #migratemons -1, and fills every free square with 1000 peaceful brown molds. Seed, clock, character and keys were chosen for this path.
